steps.content: When madness and desire burn themselves out, calm returns after indulgence runs its course. The show nears its end, and the curtain slowly falls.
The stage fills with pinpricks of light. In the gentle spotlight, the golden figure appears once more.
(A quiet solo for the finale. Adapt a short segment from the PV song, within 15 seconds, single playback; lyrics related to missing a lover and expressing love, slow and drawn-out)

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Thank you. Tonight, this song is for my love far away.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You taught me to love this world, and you gave the jewel her light. Thank you for letting me shine.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: May you all find your true love. May happiness find us all.

The revelry gives way to serenity. In the quiet music, the Jewel of Euphoria is bathed in a soft golden glow, her tender devotion soothing all restlessness. In the name of love, she offers them all a gentle forgiveness.
[Scene Change - The Stage at Curtain Call]

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Thank you for the dreamlike performance, for this intoxicating song. Thank you, Jewel of Euphoria, for this ode to true love.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Well then, Milly's performance has ended, but the wonderful evening has only just begun.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Our most honored guests—please, savor this honeyed night to your heart’s content.

He gives an elegant bow. Amid applause and lights, the beautiful dancers descend from the stage, letting the guests slip arms around their slender waists and lead them toward the bars and booths in cheerful banter.
In a corner of the stage, where the lights don't reach, Sallie is slumped on the floor. Her knees are bruised, her ankle too swollen to support her weight, but this pain means nothing to her now.

She watches the floor below, where the smoky haze and amorous light catch on the expensive velvet of the guests' garb. Hands slink from beneath satin robes, brazenly plundering the dancers' crimson lips. Eyes leer through slits in the masks, filled with nauseating, carnal greed.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...True love? Happiness? In <color=#fb9259>a place like this</color>?

Honey is still dripping from her body, sticking bank notes to her like filthy labels. A few are shoved into her lingerie, others tucked into her stockings. Sallie can't stop laughing, as if the sound itself could restrain the flood of tears.
She laughs and laughs, fighting back tears. She will not cry in this place. This hellhole deserves only her curse.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Go to hell. Go to hell, all of you...
